verdict_rule: run-pair one-sided paired t, alpha 0.05, no multiplicity correction for verdicts, Holm-adjusted p recorded; language-level hypotheses use a one-sided permutation test of Spearman correlation

gates.language_inclusion: p_l >= 0.05 and q_l >= 0.10 and verified-target items in F >= 56
gates.rl_noise: rerun SD <= 3.0pp in both languages; English 3 of 4 above start
gates.imprint_manipulation: teacher Latin-script mass (first 16 positions, student prefixes): T-en - T-def >= 0.10 in 3 of 4 languages; teacher-sample target ratio: T-def - T-en >= 0.30
gates.gap_manipulation: teacher lenient pass@1: T-priv - T-def >= 0.10 in 3 of 4 languages
gates.allocation_M5: M3a or M3a-p supported and mean D(A) - mean D(B) >= 6pp in the grid
gates.washout_M6: SFT-end (W - N) on non-English >= +2pp, 3 of 4 pilot seeds positive

m3_pilot.rule: before the rest of grid G: D on the highest-p and lowest-p included languages, first 2 grid seeds; the rest of G runs only if |D(low p) - D(high p)| >= 4 pp
m3_pilot.kept_when_no_go: OPD T-def runs of the M1 and M4 languages (the reference arms of M1b and M4) and the G-ref SFT runs of the M1 languages
m3_pilot.effect_on_verdicts: none (a compute stop rule); in parallel mode it is computed and recorded only

gates.washout_M6_eval: the pilot gate uses SFT-end evaluation a; the verdict's SFT-end difference uses evaluation b (independent of the gate)

M1a.contrast: r(SFT | T-def targets) - r(SFT | T-en targets)

M3a.predictor_pair: M3a (g) and M3a-p (p) form one Holm family of two; each is supported when its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05

M6a.contrast: (W - N) at SFT end - (W - N) after RL, non-English accuracy

M6b.contrast: (W - N) at SFT end - (W - N) after RL, target-language ratio

requires: range of p over included languages >= 0.15
M3a-p.rationale: RL gets no reward signal on groups where all samples fail, which is most groups when p_l is low; OPD still gets a dense per-token signal. Prediction: D falls as p rises.

reporting_condition: M1 and M4 are described as supported only if the pair-level test, the per-language sign count (>= 3 of 4), and the seed-aggregated direction agree
selection_rules: languages for M1, M4, M5, M6 are computed from stage-0 files only; file hashes recorded here before the grid starts

implementation.gates: src/mlopd/gates.py (pure rules) and src/mlopd/experiment.py gate_* (file inputs, sha256 of every input file)

selection_file_hashes: written after stage 0: every gate COMPLETE.json carries the sha256 of its input files and of gates.py (input_files, gates_source_sha256); the language selections are read from gates/a-u<updates>/COMPLETE.json

execution.parallel_blocks: configs/h100.json: after stage 0 every block is queued at once (G with all ten languages and six seeds, I, K, A, W, B, X). Gates are computed from the same files as in sequential mode and decide the label of each result: a block whose gate failed is reported as 'record (gate no-go)', never as a verdict, and is left out of the Holm family. Verdicts use the pre-registered seeds (grid: 4, or 6 when the RL-noise gate fails) and the included languages; the extra seeds and languages are records.
execution.reason: the user's decision of 2026-11-25: a failed gate should not leave the cluster idle or cost calendar time; GPU time is not the constraint

paper_focus: main claim: the transfer of the teacher's reasoning-language convention by OPD (M1) and the accuracy-versus-convention trade-off of the privileged teacher (M4); method-utility prediction (M3, M5) is the secondary claim

decisions.question: imprint gate, second condition (T-en teacher ratio drop >= 0.30)
decisions.decision: counted per language, 3 of 4, like the first condition
decisions.reason: the design states '3 of 4' for the first condition only; one counting rule for both keeps the gate symmetric

decisions.question: S0 and the per-seed splits
decisions.decision: S0 (256 items) is shared by all seeds (split_seed 20261124); F and U are drawn per seed from P - S0
decisions.reason: p_l, q_l, g_l must be measured on the same items in every seed; seed-to-seed variation of F and U is part of the run variance the design wants to measure

decisions.question: items and seeds for p_l and r^S_l
decisions.decision: measured on S0, the same items as q_l, averaged over the four grid seeds' handoff checkpoints
decisions.reason: g_l = q_l - p_l is only meaningful on common items

decisions.question: languages of the handoff SFT
decisions.decision: a language enters the handoff SFT if, in every grid seed, at least 56 of the 112 F items have a verified teacher solution (minimum over seeds)
decisions.reason: all seeds then share one SFT language set, so seeds differ only in items and randomness

decisions.question: M6 evaluations
decisions.decision: SFT-end checkpoint evaluated twice: evaluation b (second_eval_seed) gives the SFT-end difference in the contrast; evaluation a (eval_seed) is the start value of the RL change and the input of the M6 gate
decisions.reason: the gate must not select on the evaluation used in the contrast; the start value must not share noise with the SFT-end difference (design 2.3)

decisions.question: M2b and X languages
decisions.decision: M2b: the first two M1 languages (M1 order: r^S_l descending, ties by p_l); X: English and the included non-English language with the largest g_l
decisions.reason: M2b needs languages where M1 is measured; X needs one language at the end of the predictor range

decisions.question: form of the teacher conditions
decisions.decision: T-en is a system message on the teacher side only; T-priv adds 'The same problem in English:' and the English parallel question to the user turn; the student prompt is identical in all conditions
decisions.reason: the design says 'teacher system instruction' for T-en; T-priv must change only the teacher's input

decisions.question: S0-b conditions
decisions.reason: a_l is solve_en - solve_native; the two controls separate the effect of any extra instruction line from the language instruction

decisions.question: Appendix B rule 3
decisions.decision: a space-like separator is removed only when exactly three digits follow it
decisions.reason: '1 000' is one number, '3 4' stays two numbers

decisions.question: auxiliary scores
decisions.decision: lenient_ascii = lenient_norm with rules 2 and 4 off; lenient_legacy / strict_legacy = the English record's rules on the raw text, used only by the scorer gate
decisions.reason: keeps the English record comparable and gives the over-scoring bound of Appendix B rule 7

decisions.question: r of a response without letters
decisions.decision: r is None; such samples are left out of r means and of the item bootstrap, and count as not language-matched
decisions.reason: a ratio is undefined without letters; the match rate keeps them in the denominator so they cannot raise it

decisions.question: RL groups with equal rewards
decisions.decision: advantages are 0, the update is applied (no gradient) and counts toward the 128 updates; the number of such updates is recorded
decisions.reason: English record rule (kdrl/stage_data); resampling would give RL more samples than OPD at equal updates

decisions.question: M2b baseline
decisions.decision: non-inferiority of the language-match rate against the handoff checkpoint (margin 3 pp); accuracy against plain OPD under T-en recorded

decisions.question: Qwen2.5 default system prompt (pair X)
decisions.decision: the chat template's default system message is kept for student and teacher; pair X has no T-en or T-priv runs, so it is never replaced
decisions.reason: no condition differs in the system message within pair X

decisions.question: seeds used by the verdicts when all blocks run at once
decisions.decision: the grid verdicts use the first 4 grid seeds, or all 6 if the RL-noise gate (gates/b) fails; runs on the other seeds are records
decisions.reason: the six-seed grid is run for speed; the registered seed count stays the one the design fixes

registration_record: git tag prereg-multilingual-v1 on the commit that adds this file version, pushed to the private GitHub repository 33modeling/opd-multilingual-acl2027 before any multilingual run; no external registry
changes_after_registration: none allowed for hypotheses, tests, gates or selection rules; any change is a new version with a new tag, and results under the old version are reported as such
